summary: Qualify each exact Release Please merge candidate once instead of rebuilding the same release payload in both CI and candidate staging.
security: The required candidate status remains bound to the exact merge-queue SHA and still requires the five-database, Operaton, package, chart, image, scan, signature, and receipt gates.
Pipeline implementation changes continue to run the read-only release-readiness rehearsal before merge.
documentation: The maintainer CI and release routing documentation explains the single authoritative heavy candidate gate.
knownLimitations: This change removes duplicate work; it does not reduce the scope of the authoritative Release Candidate Stage.
rollback: Revert the CI condition and aggregate selection expression to restore readiness qualification on Release Please heads and merge groups.
validation: Run release-readiness and candidate-workflow contract tests, change-classifier fixtures, aggregate coverage checks, and release-note preflight.
Verify a release-only generated delta skips the duplicate readiness job while the merge-queue candidate still requires signed staging.
